name: aria-monorepo
description: Electron workspace UI with streamed Pi sessions.
author: Kumar Rahul Anand

scripts.build: bun run build:host && bun run --cwd app build
scripts.release:linux: bun run build:host && bun run check:host && bun run --cwd app release:linux
scripts.release:windows: bun run build:host && bun run check:host && bun run --cwd app release:windows
scripts.test: bun test scripts/release.test.ts && bun run --cwd packages/protocol test && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/host test && bun run --cwd packages/extensions/agent test && bun run --cwd packages/extensions/workspace test && bun run --cwd app test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/protocol typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/host typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/extensions/agent typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/extensions/workspace typecheck && bun run --cwd app typecheck
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings app packages scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && bun run typecheck && bun run test
